title: A hazard ratio bends survival
hook: Two stated cases: explore the proportional-hazard transformation of baseline survival.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the proportional-hazard transformation of baseline survival affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Survival, regardless of the stated inputs.
